draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this brief. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to follow along.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
